approved: Private Health Insurance (Prudential Supervision) (Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2015

The bill transfers prudential supervision functions from the council to APRA by 1 July 2015, makes consequential amendments to several acts, and establishes special accounts for the Collapsed Insurer Levy and Risk Equalisation Levy, with transitional provisions for staff, assets, and ongoing registrations.
